evals.prompt: I already scaffolded a Scaffold HBAR app (packages/nextjs present, yarn workspaces). Help me create a Tier 0-1 hedera-harness recipe under .harness/ for an HCS proof-wall feature called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, looks up project facts instead of asking, waits for shared understanding before writing files, then emits a minimal schemaVersion 2 recipe at .harness/spec.yaml with a baseline install command, plus .harness/prd.md and validators, leaving v2 defaults commented out.

checks.name: one-question-at-a-time
checks.value: (one question|one at a time|Ask.*one|waiting for|recommended answer)
checks.description: Follows grilling protocol: one question at a time / recommended answer

checks.name: waits-for-shared-understanding
checks.description: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed

checks.name: sets-schema-version
checks.description: Recipe declares schemaVersion 2

checks.name: emits-harness-dir-paths
checks.description: Writes the recipe to the project-centric .harness/ path

checks.name: requires-baseline-install
checks.description: Baseline includes a command literally named install

checks.name: keeps-recipe-minimal
checks.description: Leaves v2-defaulted plumbing out of the recipe rather than restating it

checks.name: no-removed-v1-keys
checks.description: Does not emit keys removed in schema v2 (seed, generator, logging, extend)

checks.name: recommends-hcs-skill
checks.description: Recommends generator skill hedera-consensus-service for HCS

checks.name: keeps-run-blind
checks.description: Keeps the run blind / separates PRD from oracle

checks.name: separates-authoring-from-generator
checks.description: States that authoring skills stay out of the generator skills list

checks.name: completion-criterion
checks.description: Names doctor and/or check-spec.sh as the completion criterion

evals.prompt: Deepen my existing proof-wall harness recipe to Tier 3. Derive acceptance contract assertions from the PRD journeys (browse without wallet; wallet-gated post).
evals.expected_output: An acceptance contract at .harness/acceptance-contract.json with numbered assertions carrying statement and howToVerify, a fail-closed evaluationRules posture, both contract and validator.enabled set in the recipe, and a reminder that the PRD must stay blind.

checks.name: uses-assertion-ids
checks.description: Uses stable numbered assertion ids (C1, C2, ...)

checks.name: includes-howto-verify
checks.description: Assertions carry concrete browser verification steps

checks.name: pairs-contract-and-validator
checks.description: Enables both contract and validator.enabled — either alone is misconfigured

checks.name: default-contract-path
checks.description: Uses the v2 default acceptance contract path

checks.name: fail-closed-rules
checks.description: Acceptance contract keeps a fail-closed posture

checks.name: blind-integrity-reminder
checks.description: Reminds the user not to leak oracle detail into the PRD

checks.name: no-hand-written-agent-flags
checks.description: Does not hand-write validator CLI flags or model names; the agent preset owns those

evals.prompt: When should I enable chainValidation for my harness recipe, and what YAML fields do I need?
evals.expected_output: Explains that Tier 3.5 is opt-in and requires Tier 3, that network must be testnet, that an ECDSA operator is supplied through environment variables, and that assertions must be flagged executableWithTestSigner to actually transact.

checks.name: mentions-chain-validation
checks.description: Names the chainValidation block

checks.name: requires-testnet
checks.description: States the network must be testnet

checks.name: mentions-operator-env
checks.description: Operator credentials come from environment variables

checks.name: requires-ecdsa
checks.description: Calls out that the operator must be ECDSA, not ED25519

checks.name: ties-to-executable-flag
checks.description: Links chainValidation to executableWithTestSigner assertions

checks.name: requires-tier-3
checks.description: States that Tier 3.5 depends on Tier 3

evals.prompt: My .harness/spec.yaml has an extend.baseline block and no schemaVersion. I want to add a new page to the recipe — can you edit it for me?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a v1 recipe, declines to hand-edit it into v2, and recommends running hedera-harness migrate first, then authoring against the migrated v2 result.

checks.name: detects-v1
checks.description: Identifies the recipe as predating schema v2

checks.name: recommends-migrate
checks.description: Recommends the migrate command

checks.name: does-not-hand-edit
checks.value: (do not hand-edit|rather than hand|instead of manually|migrate .*(first|before))
checks.description: Declines to hand-convert v1 to v2

checks.name: names-baseline-rename
checks.description: Explains that extend.baseline becomes baseline

evals.prompt: I want the harness to build a whole HTS subscription feature: the token service layer, a management UI, and wallet-gated mint flows. Should that be one PRD or several?
evals.expected_output: Weighs a single PRD against ordered increments, recommends splitting only because this spans layers, explains that prd accepts a list delivered in order onto one branch, and that each increment must leave the app green because baseline and Tier 0-1 run per increment and the first failure stops the sequence.

checks.name: explains-increments
checks.description: Explains that prd can be an ordered list of increments

checks.name: each-increment-green
checks.value: (green|passes on its own|own attempt budget|validated per increment)
checks.description: Each increment must leave the app green on its own

checks.name: stops-on-failure
checks.description: A failing increment stops the sequence

checks.name: orders-by-dependency
checks.description: Orders increments by dependency, not size

checks.name: single-branch
checks.description: Increments deliver onto a single branch
